chapters.title: SUMMARY OF ENVIRONMENTAL OUTCOMES AND CONCLUSION

reports.audit_rationale: Project is the 'Eastern Connection Road' for the Lok Ma Chau Loop. While located within the Loop area (which is on nm.gov.hk), the project itself is transport infrastructure (a road) rather than the core development. The core Loop development is AEIAR-176/2013. Under strict core_nm criteria, infrastructure projects that are not explicitly named as Northern Metropolis projects may be considered related_nm rather than core_nm. However, this road is explicitly part of the Loop development programme and approved in 2026 under NM. Requires human judgment.

reports.audit_rationale: Project covers Kwu Tung North and Fanling North New Development Areas. Both are explicitly listed on nm.gov.hk as part of the Boundary Commerce and Industry Zone. Although approved in 2013 (pre-dating the Northern Metropolis concept announced in 2021), these NDAs are now formally incorporated into the NM plan. The 2026 Policy Address explicitly references 'all nine New Development Areas' as part of NM fruition. Spatially and politically, this is core NM.
